capabilities: Convert YouTube URLs pasted on empty lines into markdown, iframe, or div embeds
Recognize youtu.be, Shorts, and embed URL formats
Route restricted-video embeds through a configurable Invidious instance
Let users choose the default embed style in settings
disambiguation: Despite the name, it currently handles only YouTube URLs; other providers like Vimeo are roadmap goals, not features.
extras: Roadmap features (more providers, auto-imported metadata) are gated behind GitHub star milestones and not yet available; embeds for restricted videos can bypass YouTube Error 153 via Invidious.
problem: Obsidian leaves pasted YouTube links as plain URLs, so users must manually write embed syntax or HTML to get a video player.

relations.evidence: Enable Use alternative embed server in settings to route embeds through an Invidious instance instead.

summary: Paste-trigger plugin that converts YouTube URLs pasted on an empty line into markdown, iframe, or div embeds.
